name: Explore – Search Results

navigation.notes: **Reached from GST-001** — search is reached from home. Stated on 4 September: this screen exited somewhere and nothing exited to it, so it was outside the navigation graph entirely.

transitions.provenance: derived — GST-001 declares entryState.params  and GST-063 holds none of them. The edge carries nothing: GST-063 is opened from GST-001, so this edge is the way back and GST-001 keeps its own state

notes:
Added 17 August for parity with WEB-003. **Not on the wireframe board** — needs drawing. CF-93.

**Rev 3 (decided 29 September).** Search returns info-only products flagged; they show `notBookableLabel` and open their details, and are hidden when `showInfoOnly` is off (REV3-14).

**Mobile v4 (decided 29 September, MOB-1).** The search-results state of GST-002 Explore: **one implementation with GST-002, both ids kept** (as GAP-D3). `searchCatalogue` also takes `guidedAnswerIds` (W4) when the guest came through Help me choose.
patternReason: `searchCatalogue` reads a population and nothing reads one of them; the detail is the row until a `get` exists
purpose: Find something when you do not know what it is called.

components.label: Results
components.provenance: decided by Chinmay, fix before Block A starts, 2 October 2026 (GFIX-3)
components.notes: One card per result: name, summary, photo (`primaryMedia`), from-price (`fromPrice`), sold out shown rather than hidden (`isAvailable`), and `notBookableLabel` for an info-only product. `searchCatalogue` answers with no named schema, so the card binds none. Was the generated table 'Every money'; staff and plumbing columns removed (decided by Chinmay, fix before Block A starts, 2 October 2026 (GFIX-3)).

states.error: Could not load. Names which read failed and leaves the search untouched.
states.emptyFirstRun: No search yet. **Offers no create action** — this screen declares no operation that makes one — and says so rather than showing an empty table.
states.emptyNoResults: Nothing matches what was typed. Names the search, suggests a shorter one and offers to clear it; a sold-out match is shown as sold out, not hidden.
states.offline: **The offline banner shows.** Results come only from what was already loaded, with a note that newer items may exist.

apisNote: Rebuilt 9 September 2026 from the 1 operation this screen declares, not from a workshop pack — it has none. Columns narrowed on 3 October 2026 to the fields the screen is about (CHG-SPF-002): at most five on a phone or handheld, plumbing and foreign ids left to the record itself.

offlineBanner.message: You're offline. Connect to the internet to book, pay, order or join a queue.
offlineBanner.shows: The moment the connection drops, on every screen, above the screen's own content.
offlineBanner.clears: By itself as soon as the connection is back, with a short "Back online" confirmation.
offlineBanner.never: Covers what is already on screen, or appears for a server error — that is the screen's own error state, and a guest told they are offline when the venue is down reconnects for nothing.
offlineBanner.provenance: Decided 12 September 2026 — guest web and guest app behave identically offline and say so with the same banner.

targetApp.name: TICVAI Guest
targetApp.note: **One guest product in three shells.** Web, mobile and kiosk share 73–91% of their operations; the kiosk is the same product in a fixed frame with no keyboard, and is deliberately narrower rather than different.
